evidence.source: read-only inspection of actual running PID 10056, 2026-10-26

root_cause: Parser rejected assigned recipient ID 2 because initial slot list did not yet contain its occupied row. It then invalidated the captured connection before later SLOTINFO update.
fix: Accept a nonzero unique recipient assignment on an already observed incoming-join socket, retain the binding, and require an occupied human row with matching ID/name/socket before Act or automatic ban enforcement.
host_identity: When no external local name exists, infer only the unique human row without an accepted peer and require PLAYERINFO sent by this process for that ID; ambiguous rows refuse inference. A later differing native identity clears all proof.
